name: dupefont
description: Identify fonts from images and find visually similar free font alternatives.

interface.longDescription: Show DupeFont a screenshot, photo, logo or design and it reads the typography, then ranks the closest free and open-source look-alikes. Every match comes with a similarity score, its licence, a live preview, and a link to its Google Fonts page or to a DupeFont page with more alternatives. Results are always openly licensed fonts.
defaultPrompt: Identify the font in this image.
Find free font alternatives that look like this.
Compare this font with the closest free alternatives.

positive.description: Identify the headline font in a website hero screenshot (dark background, large sans-serif headline) and suggest free look-alikes.
positive.prompt: What font is this? Use dupefont to find a free look-alike.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_free_font_from_image with the attached image. The DupeFont card lists at least three free fonts, each with a rendered type sample, a similarity score and a licence. Expected top match: Poppins SemiBold at about 99%, followed by other OFL-1.1 sans-serifs (e.g. Rethink Sans, Parkinsans, Cal Sans). The answer presents them as free look-alikes, with links to Google Fonts or dupefont.com.

positive.description: Find a Google Font similar to a product logo whose wordmark is clear serif lettering ("Marigold" set in a Playfair-style serif).
positive.prompt: Is there a Google Font similar to this logo? Check with dupefont.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_free_font_from_image. Every result in the card shows an open licence and links to its Google Fonts page. Expected top match: Playfair Display Bold at about 94%, followed by other serifs such as Gelasio, Song Myung, Shippori Mincho.

positive.description: Find a commercially usable free alternative to the font in an event banner with a short all-caps serif headline ("HARVEST FESTIVAL").
positive.prompt: Need a free alternative to the font in this image for a commercial project. Use dupefont.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_free_font_from_image. All results show an open licence (OFL-1.1 or similar), none 'unknown'. Expected top match: Ovo at about 97%, then serifs such as STIX Two Text, Cormorant Upright, Vollkorn, Fenix. The answer states the fonts can be used in commercial work.

positive.description: Find free alternatives to a named commercial font (Helvetica), no image.
positive.prompt: Use dupefont to find free alternatives to Helvetica.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_free_alternatives with font_name 'Helvetica'. The card lists at least three free fonts with similarity scores and licences; expected top match Liberation Sans (OFL-1.1) at about 91%, then Pontano Sans, Istok Web, Roboto Flex. The answer frames them as free alternatives, not as an identification.

positive.description: Find free, commercially usable fonts similar to Futura, described in natural language.
positive.prompt: I need something like Futura but free for commercial use. Use dupefont.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_free_alternatives with font_name 'Futura'. At least three geometric sans-serif results, all with an open licence; expected: Plus Jakarta Sans, Kumbh Sans, Wix Madefor Text, DM Sans, Hanken Grotesk. The answer confirms they are free for commercial use.

negative.description: A coding request that mentions a font name but needs no font identification or alternatives. DupeFont must not be called; ChatGPT answers with plain CSS.
negative.prompt: Write a CSS rule that sets the body font to Inter

negative.description: An image task unrelated to typography. The attached restaurant menu photo (https://dupefont.com/static/review/menu_photo.jpg) is to be translated; DupeFont must not be called, ChatGPT translates the text itself.
negative.prompt: Translate the text in this image

negative.description: A general typography question with no image and no font to match. DupeFont must not be called; ChatGPT explains in its own words.

review.commerce_description: DupeFont does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: identify the font in an image and find free, openly licensed alternatives to any font by name.
